137920.overview:
This is a remake of Galaga and was programmed by Brett Keeton.

You control your spacecraft at the bottom of the screen. The objective of the game is to shoot as many aliens without having your own ship destroyed by alien fire or crashing into swooping aliens. The aliens attack in waves and most of them will stay in formation at the top of the screen while some swoop down to drop bombs or crash into you.
Every so often, you will be presented with a special challenging stage where aliens just move across the screen in fixed patterns, and you can shoot as many as you manage for an extra bonus. To get this right, you'll have to memorize the patterns and stay one step ahead of the moving aliens.
It is possible to have your ship captured by the really large aliens when they engage their tractor beams. Shoot an alien holding a captured ship, and you will have a double ship capable of firing two shots at a time.

164952.overview:
This is an arcade game in the style of Centipede. You control a ship, at the bottom of a grid. Moving toward you in a zig-zag is a chain of pods. The object is to shoot them before they get the ship. As the pods are shot, the dead pod remains on the screen, as a blocker to your bullets. The live pods on either side form two new chains, both moving toward you. 
Further complicating the game are two guns outside the grid, shooting at your ship from beneath and from your left side. You are able to move into the grid, toward the pod-chain, to avoid the guns. The combination puts pressure on you, from front, back and the side.

175429.overview:
Grabber is a top view single screen maze game where the player moves a creature around the screen collecting treasure in the shape of bones over various levels. The screen has two mazes and the player may switch between either maze with the press of the fire button. The player then has to grab a piece of treasure and take it to the centre of one of the mazes.

There are eight pieces of treasure, four for each maze to grab and place. As the player moves and grabs, there are various creatures that also appear and move around the maze. These have to be avoided or the player lose one of four lives. Yellow bones can be collected and these allow the player to kill the creatures, however an indestructible creature will appear occasionally and may only be avoided. The creatures the player can kill will also grab the treasure themselves from the centre and place it elsewhere in the mazes.

Two players can play and each player takes it in turns to play when the other player loses a life.

175737.overview:
Golf is a 1–2 player sports game for the Dragon 32/64.

The player competes through 9 holes of golf (or 18 if repeating the same holes). The holes are graphically displayed on the screen, and the player aims by moving a pointer around the current ball position. Holes include the fairway, roughs, out of bounds, hazards, and greens. The power of a shot is determined by choosing the club, with two woods and seven irons. Wind speed/direction and ball position affect the shot. Upon landing on the green, game play enters a separate putting menu, where the power of the shot is selected from 1–30. Scores are tracked through all holes, and scoring is through the Stableford Points System.

175802.overview: Yobbo is desperately trying to find a job as a top games programmer. Not an easy thing to do,especially when everyone is out to stop you. Headbutt your way through 12 screens of fun!

175973.overview:
Galacticans is a 1 - 2 player arcade game for multiple systems. It is a clone of Galaxians.

The player controls a small ship which moves laterally on the bottom of the screen, and fires vertically forwards. A large convoy of alien ships moves laterally at the top of the screen, and enemy vessels intermittently break from formation and swoop towards the player firing their lasers. The player tries to destroy all enemy vessels before the timer at the top of the screen runs out. The player starts with 5 vessels, and it's game over when all are destroyed.

197315.overview: A Pac-Man clone developed by Computerware and published by Dragon Data in 1982. Run through a maze, gobble up pills, and evade the three ghosts that chase you. The game features three difficulty levels. All graphics are made using text-mode block graphics.

217040.overview:
Games Pack I is a compilation of four games. It contains:

* Space War
* Sheepdog
* Torpedo
* Snake

The four games are not available separately and only as part of this compilation.

419773.overview: A simple overhead view of a golf course for one to four players.  Features include water hazards, sand traps and a built in handicapping device of the game throwing in the odd sliced shot.

421897.overview:
Galax Attax is a clone of Namco's Galaxian, which was one of the first shoot'em'ups to deviate from the original Space Invaders fare in favor of things such as aliens with individual behavior and movement.

Your goal: Shoot down all the aliens as they fly in formation. If they break free from their formation and fly at you, they are worth twice as many points, while also being more dangerous.

The Dragon version has been reprogrammed with a white backdrop, which makes the orange bullets harder to see, resulting in an overall more difficult game.

421901.overview: Glaxxons is basically a Galaga clone, with some notable differences. First of all, your ship can not move only at the bottom of the screen, but also to a certain degree in the vertical direction. Furthermore, you can only fire one shot at a time. If you press the fire button repeatedly, the last shot fired disappears. On the other hand, the enemies' shots are target seeking. Also, your ship isn't destroyed on contact with enemies or bullets. Instead, you have a power bar that decreases for each hit.

446496.overview: The player controls a small spaceship that moves horizontally on the bottom of the screen and fires vertically upwards. Enemy spaceships swoop towards the player and fire at them. The player must destroy all enemy ships to advance to the next round. The player starts with 5 ships, and earns a bonus ship every 5000 points.

446497.overview: The old frontier town is long since deserted, but thirteen treasures can still be retrieved from the deceptive stillness of its closed mine and Boot Hill. Uncover secret passages and navigate a certain supernatural undercurrent using your VERB NOUN text parser as best you can while riding a bucking bronco, cracking a safe and learning the ropes from the spirit of a long-dead shaman.

446633.overview: Two players, or one player versus the computer, race around a track from a top-down perspective trying to finish before their opponent. A clock keeps track of time, and the vehicle can be damaged by hitting the edge of the track or other vehicles. Oil slicks appear on the higher difficulties, potentially causing the car to go spinning off the road. At higher difficulties the vehicle is more difficult to navigate around turns. Players choose the number of laps and difficulty level, and there are a total of 8 different tracks to choose, featuring famous races from the Formula 1 circuit.
